record.title: Jaber security closure and phased cargo/passenger reopening, 2021
record.direction: Both directions as observed at reopening.
record.movement: Passengers and goods initially; later mainly passenger restrictions
record.exceptions: Cargo restored 4 August. Limited small-merchant passenger trips existed before the 29 September easing; precise dates of those exceptions are not reconstructed.
record.enforcement: Scope-limited evidence; uniform enforcement beyond the named crossings and movement categories is not inferred.
record.status_observation: Historical evidence in cited sources only; no present-status inference.
record.context: Daraa fighting interrupted plans to expand crossing capacity. Cargo resumed 4 August; observed broader vehicle/passenger resumption followed on 29 September.
record.uncertainty: Initial closure is ministry-reported. Not all passengers were barred continuously until September: The National documents earlier limited merchant trips. September removed transfer requirements and eased travel but retained limits. No all-traffic or all-passenger duration.

historical.duration_note: Not eligible for a single continuous-duration calculation; see movement scope, phases and uncertainty
